TC-08/S20.title: Send under faults: failed send, retry, double-click, sender clock +2 days
TC-08/S20.detail: Local 8b4be94a, fresh @roundai.test accounts; no model: handoff/persistence:ensure answered at the Convex socket (ts 0, nothing scheduled), every ai/* refused, charts carry stored stand-in summaries re-inserted with `convex import --append` (ho-support.ts); tripwire 'no model call' on every run. Sender context Pacific/Honolulu, clock +2 days (stored session read as expired; UI sign-in with a local test code). First handoffs:send failed at the socket: dialog stays open with the edited text, message 'The handoff couldn’t be sent. Nothing left the app — try again.', no 'Sent to', no row either side, no email fallback; retry → exactly 1 Received row; sentAt 2026-10-19T20:01:52Z = server time (not +2 days); double-click on the confirming Send → exactly one more row (2). Recorded Q8: title 'Patient Handoff — Oct 21, 2026' and text header 'Wednesday, October 21, 2026 · 10:01 AM' come from the sender's device clock (server day Oct 19/20).
